product: MCP tools in Genie Agents are generally available
tagline: MCP tools in Genie Agents are now generally available.
what_it_does: MCP tools in Genie Agents are now generally available. Authors can attach external MCP servers registered in Unity Gateway, in addition to Databricks provided connectors, and the Agent mode APIs support MCP tools. A Genie Agent can use MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools to pull context from and take actions in external tools and sources.
why_it_matters: Databricks governs every tool call through Unity Catalog and Unity Gateway.
